name: Naloxegol
aliases: AZ-13337019, AZ13337019, Movantik®, NKTR 118, NKTR-118, NKTR118
summary: Naloxegol (INN; PEGylated naloxol; trade names Movantik and Moventig) is a peripherally acting μ-opioid receptor antagonist developed by AstraZeneca, licensed from Nektar Therapeutics, for the treatment of opioid-induced constipation. It was approved in 2014 in adult patients with chronic, non-cancer pain. Doses of 25 mg were found safe and well tolerated for 52 weeks.

pharmacology.text: Naloxegol (INN; PEGylated naloxol; trade names Movantik and Moventig) is a peripherally acting μ-opioid receptor antagonist developed by AstraZeneca, licensed from Nektar Therapeutics, for the treatment of opioid-induced constipation.

uses.text: Naloxegol is indicated for the treatment of opioid-induced constipation (OIC) in people with chronic non-cancer pain.

sideEffects.text: The most common side effects are abdominal pain, diarrhea, nausea, flatulence, vomiting, and headache.
